rejected.text: Qal Sisma is an inhospitable mountain range where the Temur have their clanholds and where Ugin's grave lies.
In the Chronicle of Bolas, the hunting party camps in the range and crosses it before reaching the high plateau.
It is also where Atarka flies after her feast, and where Ugin's grave lies.
The latest page, in 2018, describes Qal Sisma as the mountain range where Ugin's grave lies.
